facility.name: King Steps Academy
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Animals: The operation does not address in the operational policies about animals they have. The operation has two dogs and one cat.     Corrected:  When primary caregiver updated the operational policy about animals in the home.

Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operation did not address promoting indoor and outdoor physical activity in the operational policies.      Corrected:  When primary caregiver updated the operational policy about promoting indoor and outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver only had 12 hours for training year 4-11-2025 to 4-11-2026. The primary caregivers is still missing 18 hours.       Corrected:  When the inspector took 18 hours of training for 4-11-2026 to 4-11-2027.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The operation did not address Parent Rights in the operational policies.     Corrected:  When primary caregiver updated the operational policy with parent rights.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: The operation is missing information in the emergency preparedness plan on how children younger than 24 months and limited mobility would get out of the home in case of an emergency.       Corrected:  When added the information to the emergency preparedness plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The primary caregiver did not have current first aid training, it expired 7/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on: The primary caregiver did not have current CPR training, it expired 7/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects: This had not been done since March 16, 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects (26 TAC §745.651(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Complete Kit: First aid kit in transportation van is missing scissors.     Note: Scissors were placed in kit during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Complete Kit (26 TAC §747.3803(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There are two stacks of wood in the backyard that could potentially fall over if children were to mess with the small logs. These stacks of wood are 2 feet tall.     There is a slide from the play set that is fallen over on the ground. There are sharp round edges on the posts exposed.     Note: Photos were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Tire Swings - Not Suspended from Composite Structure: A saucer tree swing is installed on a play structure swing set next to two swings in the same bay.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Tire Swings - Not Suspended from Composite Structure (26 TAC §747.4505(2))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe: A screw is sticking out approximately 1 inch from a child's rocking chair where the armrest was.  This could poke a child and injure them.     Note: Director removed screw during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §747.3501(5))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: There is a can of paint behind a curtain next to the water heater in reach of children.     Note: Director removed paint can.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §747.3203(14))
